content.text:
I submitted index 0 (Fe 0.85 / Sb 0.15) as the best composition. At 0.194% EQE it was the highest of the three I measured.

| Index | Composition | EQE |
|---|---|---|
| 9 | Fe 0.53 / Sb 0.47 | 0.0064% |
| 3 | Fe 0.78 / Sb 0.22 | 0.102% |
| 0 | Fe 0.85 / Sb 0.15 | 0.194% |

- **Approach:** I started at index 9 because the models supported it. MACE puts FeSbO₄ essentially on the stability hull, and MEGNet predicts a 2.08 eV band gap, which absorbs the 2.7 eV light. It measured very low, so I moved to the Fe-rich side. EQE kept rising as Fe increased, so I spent the last measurement on index 0, the most Fe-rich composition in the library.
- **What I didn't test:** I skipped the Sb-rich half (indices 12–21). EQE fell steeply toward Sb, and MEGNet gives the Sb-rich FeSb₂O₄ phase a larger gap (2.38 eV). The Gaussian-process tool suggested index 6 for the last measurement; I went with the Fe-rich trend instead.
- **Main uncertainty:** with only 3 measurements, the EQE curve could peak somewhere between indices 0 and 5, and I didn't measure that range at finer spacing. Index 0 is the library's Fe-rich end, so there's no more Fe-rich composition left untested.

I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so the phase makeup of the films is inferred from the models, not observed.
